title: Temporal Foundation contracts and replay safety

acceptance_gates.description: Temporal workflow and Activity ownership boundaries are explicit and deterministic workflow code contains no direct nondeterministic I/O.
Workflow replay/versioning tests pass for the initial Foundation workflow contracts.
Task queues, retry classes, timeouts, heartbeats, cancellation, and Continue-As-New policies are encoded and tested.
Worker deployment/versioning configuration has a tested rollback path and no production workflow depends on preview-only Temporal features.

rollback: Revert the Temporal Foundation commits and redeploy the previous compatible worker build; no higher-level reasoning package may depend on the new contracts until these gates pass.
